cases.answer:

Allelic activation of its receptor (different from binding site-II of group 32) causes hyperexcitability of the insect nervous system. Acetylcholine is the main excitatory neurotransmitter in the insect central nervous system. [D1]

Here, [D1] refers to the evidence citation from the New Zealand pesticide dataset.
